line.a_wyscig.text: Today is the great forest race! There are medals for the winners.

line.a_start.text: On your marks, get set, go!

line.a_zajac_wygral.text: Bunny won! He's the biggest, so he's first!

line.a_nie_najwiekszy.text: Mole, in a race it doesn't matter who is the biggest.

line.a_pierwszy.text: First is the one who reached the finish first. Then second, third, and at the end the last.

line.a_kto_pierwszy.text: Who reached the finish first? Point to them.

line.a_kto_pierwszy_nie.text: Look who touched the finish line first.

line.a_kto_ostatni.text: And who came in last? Point to them.

line.a_kto_ostatni_nie.text: That one was faster. Who arrived at the very end?

line.a_ostatnia.text: Mouse was last, but she got there too. Well done!

line.a_podium.text: Onto the podium! Put the first at the very top, on the one. The second on the two, the third on the three.

line.a_podium_nie.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_nie.sowa.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_nie.kret.text: That's not his place. Who came first, second, third?

line.a_podium_ok.text: First, second and third on the podium. Well done, everyone!

line.b_zjezdzalnia.text: Now the playground! There's a queue for the slide.

line.b_od_przodu.text: In a queue we count from the front, from the arrow: first, second, third, fourth.

line.b_trzeci.text: Who is third in the queue? Point to them.

line.b_trzeci_nie.text: Count from the arrow: first, second, third.

line.b_zjezdza.text: The first one slides down! And then goes to the end of the queue.

line.b_kto_teraz.text: Who is first now? Point to them.

line.b_kto_teraz_nie.text: Look who is standing by the arrow now.

line.b_teraz_pierwszy.text: When the first one leaves, everybody moves up.

line.b_my.text: And now Mole and Owl race to the swings! I'm the judge.

line.b_kto_pierwszy.text: Who got there first? Point to them.

line.b_kto_pierwszy_nie.text: That one came second. Who was first?

line.b_koniec.text: Now I know: first is the one who gets there first, not the biggest.

line.p_start.text: Let's practise: first, second, third, last! I have five games.

line.p_drugi.text: Who is second in the queue? Point to them.

line.p_drugi_nie.text: We count from the arrow: first, second.

line.p_ostatni.text: Who is last in the queue? Point to them.

line.p_ostatni_nie.text: The last one stands at the very end, furthest from the arrow.

line.p_wyscig.text: One more race! Watch carefully who gets there first.

line.p_podium.text: Put the winners on the podium: first, second and third.

line.p_medale.text: The gold medal is for first place, silver for second, bronze for third. Which medal does the second get? Point to it.

line.p_medale_nie.text: That one is for another place. The second gets silver.

line.p_srebrny.text: A silver medal for second place!

line.p_trzeci.text: The bronze medal is for the third in the queue. Who gets it? Point to them.

line.p_trzeci_nie.text: Count from the arrow to three.

line.h_zabawki.text: The toys are queueing up for bed.

line.h_kolejnosc.text: Teddy first, the ball second, the block third. Drag each toy to its place.

line.h_nie.text: Listen again: teddy first, the ball second, the block third.

line.h_dobrze.text: First, second, third. Good night, toys!

line.h_rodzice.text: At dinner, tell your parents who sat down at the table first, who second and who last!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for a wonderful race! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the gold medal from the forest race. We got it when we learnt who is first, second and last.
